senses.gloss: मोक n. The cast-off skin of an animal.
मोक्ष् vt. 1P, 10U (pres. मोक्षति, मोक्षयति-ते) 1. To set free, to liberate, to emancipate; 2. to loose, to untie; 3. to wrest away; 4. to cast, to fling.

मोक्ष m. 1. Liberation, release, escape, शुकादयः । लब्धमोक्षास्तदादेशाद्यथेष्टगतयोऽभवन् R.xvii.20; 2. delivery, discharge, R.xvii.19; 3. final emanicipation, liberation of the soul from further transmigration (considered as the final aim of life), R.x.84, Bg.v.27; (See पुरुषार्थ); 4. death; 5. loosening, unbinding, untying, अबलावेणिमोक्षोत्सुकानि Megh.ii.36; 6. falling down, dropping down, स्थलीर्मर्मरपत्रमोक्षाः K.S.iii.31; 7. acquittance of an obligation; 8. end of an eclipse; 9. scattering, strewing; 10. shooting, discharging.
मोक्ष-उपाय m. a means to final liberation.
मोक्ष-देव m. an epithet applied to Hiouen-thsang.
मोक्ष-पुरी f. an epithet of Kānchī.
मोक्षण n. 1. Rescuing, releasing, setting at liberty; 2. loosening; 3. giving up, resigning; 4. causing to flow.
